description: A high-priority initiative in Punjab aimed at curbing stubble burning (paddy straw) by subsidizing in-situ and ex-situ crop residue management machinery like Happy Seeders, Super Seeders, Paddy Straw Choppers, and Balers.
benefits: 50% subsidy for individual farmers and 80% subsidy for Custom Hiring Centers (CHCs), Panchayats, and Farmers Cooperative Societies on approved straw management machinery.
eligibility: Individual farmers owning agricultural land in Punjab
Registered Farmers Cooperative Societies, Panchayats, and FPOs in Punjab

description: A state infrastructure project designed to repair, widen, and pave rural link roads connecting agricultural fields to local grain markets (Mandis) to facilitate seamless crop transportation.
benefits: State-funded construction and repair of rural agricultural link roads, reducing transport time and crop spillage loss.
eligibility: Community/Panchayat-level infrastructure initiative benefiting all regional farmers in Punjab
application_mode: Offline via Punjab Mandi Board / District Agriculture Office

description: An innovative voluntary incentive scheme that encourages farmers to conserve groundwater and electricity by offering cash rewards for consuming less electricity than their allocated farm limit for tubewells.
benefits: Direct cash transfer of ₹4 per kilowatt-hour (unit) of electricity saved compared to the baseline allocation.
eligibility: Farmers in Punjab with metered agricultural tubewell electricity connections
documents: PSPCL Electricity Connection / Meter Account Number
application_mode: Online / PSPCL (Punjab State Power Corporation Limited) Offices

scheme_name: Direct Sowing of Rice (DSR) Incentive Scheme
description: Promotes direct seeding of rice instead of traditional nursery transplantation to drastically reduce groundwater consumption and labor requirements during Kharif sowing.
benefits: Direct financial incentive of ₹1,500 per acre paid directly into the farmer's bank account.
eligibility: Farmers in Punjab adopting the Direct Sowing of Rice (DSR) technique on their lands
Verification completed by local Agriculture Extension Officers

description: A state scheme providing targeted risk coverage for fruit and vegetable growers against adverse weather conditions, unseasonal rains, hail, and disease outbreaks.
benefits: Financial compensation up to ₹15,000 to ₹40,000 per acre depending on the specific horticultural crop damaged.
eligibility: Farmers cultivating notified fruit and vegetable crops in Punjab

scheme_name: Sub-Mission on Seeds and Planting Material (SMSP) - Punjab
description: Provides high-quality, certified seeds for wheat, paddy, pulses, and fodder crops at subsidized rates to raise crop yields and crop quality across the state.
benefits: 50% subsidy on the purchase of certified high-yielding seed varieties.
eligibility: All resident farmers registered on the Punjab Agriculture Department portal
application_mode: Online Portal / Punjab State Seeds Corporation (PUNSEED) Outlets

scheme_name: Punjab Dairy Development Board (PDDB) Capital Subsidy
description: Offers capital assistance for modernizing dairy units, purchasing high-yield milch cattle, and setting up automated milking machines and bulk milk coolers.
benefits: 25% subsidy for general category and 33.33% subsidy for SC category farmers on modern dairy unit setups (up to 20 cattle units).
eligibility: Farmers and unemployed youth residing in Punjab taking up dairy farming
Completion of basic dairy management training from PDDB

description: Focuses on laying Underground Pipeline Systems (UGPIP) for efficient irrigation water distribution from canals and tubewells, eliminating conveyance water losses.
benefits: 90% subsidy for group/community projects and 50% for individual landholders laying underground irrigation pipelines.
eligibility: Individual landholders or groups of minimum 3 farmers sharing a water source in Punjab
application_mode: Online via Soil and Water Conservation Department Punjab

scheme_name: Promotion of Organic and Natural Farming - Punjab
description: Encourages farmers to transition land from chemical-intensive practices to certified organic and natural farming through input grants and eco-marketing aid.
benefits: Financial assistance up to ₹10,000 per acre spread over 3 years for organic inputs, soil testing, and certification.
eligibility: Farmers in Punjab dedicating a minimum of 1 acre of land to organic farming
application_mode: Offline via District Organic Farming Cell / Online Portal

description: Provides state compensation to farmers experiencing significant crop loss caused by floods, hail, pest outbreaks, or unexpected weather disruptions.
benefits: Direct compensation up to ₹15,000 per acre for 75% to 100% crop damage.
eligibility: Farmers in notified flood-affected or natural calamity-hit districts in Punjab
documents: Girdawari Report (Special Crop Loss Assessment by Revenue Dept)
application_mode: District Revenue Officer / Local Revenue Patwari verification
